Required projection: EPSG:2269 or EPSG:32610. Tier logic: 'adequate' (>=10%), 'marginal' (5-10%), 'deficient' (<5%). The summary CSV must include total_pop (from field P1_001N in the census data) and avg_park_pct for each tier. Output files must be in /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/.
